The '''Nnar root''' was a plant root from the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Although it was naturally poisonous when unprepared, the [[Witches of Dathomir]] had discovered a manner to turn it into a general curative. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] often used incorrectly prepared Nnar roots to assassinate rival [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]].<ref name="SWG:NR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Nnar Root}}</ref>
